title: Mobility Equipment Warehouse Note — Shelf Conditioning of Battery Sets Before Delivery
content:
# Shelf Conditioning Allowance — Battery Sets on Mobility Equipment

**Note.** A shelf-conditioning allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty battery-set replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the days from the chair's order date to its delivery date: 2 units for 21 days or more, 1 unit for at least 7 but fewer than 21 days, and nothing for fewer than 7 days.

## Schedule

| Days from the order date to the delivery date | Shelf-conditioning allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 to 6 | none |
| 7 to 20 | 1 unit |
| 21 or more | 2 units |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, order received 1 April)

| Delivery date | Days from order to delivery | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 7 April | 6 | none |
| 8 April | 7 | 1 unit |
| 21 April | 20 | 1 unit |
| 22 April | 21 | 2 units |

Both dates are read from the chair's wheelchair record: the date the order was received and the delivery date.
